targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(total_cases) FILTER (WHERE location = 'World'), MAX(total_cases)) AS "Total reported cases" FROM regional_aggregates WHERE source_type = '$source_type';
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(total_deaths) FILTER (WHERE location = 'World'), MAX(total_deaths)) AS "Total reported deaths" FROM regional_aggregates WHERE source_type = '$source_type';
SELECT MAX(date) AS "Latest historical reporting date" FROM regional_aggregates WHERE source_type = 'historical';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Rows in current source" FROM regional_aggregates WHERE source_type = '$source_type';

panels.title: Rows for selected data source type
panels.description: historical = OWID load; historical_replay and synthetic are Kafka pipeline outputs and are kept separate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date AS time, SUM(new_cases) AS daily_new_cases FROM regional_aggregates WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND source_type = '$source_type' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;

SELECT date AS time, SUM(new_deaths) AS daily_new_deaths FROM regional_aggregates WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND source_type = '$source_type' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;

SELECT date AS time, AVG(rolling_7d_cases) AS cases_7d_avg, AVG(rolling_7d_deaths) AS deaths_7d_avg FROM regional_aggregates WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND source_type = '$source_type' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;

SELECT date AS time, location AS metric, SUM(new_cases) AS daily_cases FROM regional_aggregates WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND source_type = '$source_type' AND location IN ('United States','India','United Kingdom','Brazil','Germany','France','Italy','Japan') GROUP BY date, location ORDER BY date;
SELECT location, percentage_change FROM regional_trend_signals WHERE source_type = '$source_type' AND is_increasing = TRUE ORDER BY percentage_change DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Regional increase signals (recent 7d vs previous 7d)
panels.description: Statistical increase in the latest seven-day average of daily cases versus the preceding week. Not an outbreak prediction or medical claim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT location, ROUND(AVG(case_fatality_ratio)::numeric, 3) AS cfr_percent FROM regional_aggregates WHERE source_type = '$source_type' AND case_fatality_ratio IS NOT NULL AND continent IS NOT NULL AND continent <> '' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') GROUP BY location ORDER BY cfr_percent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Case-fatality ratio comparison (%)
panels.description: CFR = cumulative deaths / cumulative cases. Sensitive to testing, reporting lags, and age structure. Missing totals are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT location, date, new_cases, new_deaths, rolling_7d_cases, rolling_7d_deaths, ROUND(case_fatality_ratio::numeric, 3) AS cfr_percent, source_type FROM regional_aggregates WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND source_type = '$source_type' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') ORDER BY date DESC, location LIMIT 200;
SELECT source_type, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date, SUM(new_cases) AS sum_daily_cases FROM regional_aggregates GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY source_type;

panels.title: Historical vs replayed vs synthetic identification
panels.description: Do not mix synthetic rows into historical KPIs. Grafana variable source_type defaults to historical.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.process_name, s.status, s.records_in, s.records_out, s.records_quarantined, s.last_error, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quarantined_records) AS quarantined_records FROM pipeline_status s ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC;

panels.title: Pipeline health, ingestion counts, and processing errors

targets.rawSql: SELECT location, date, recent_7d_avg, previous_7d_avg, percentage_change, is_increasing, observation_count, explanation, source_type FROM regional_trend_signals WHERE source_type = '$source_type' AND ('$country' = 'All' OR location = '$country') ORDER BY is_increasing DESC, percentage_change DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50;
